visualCharacteristics.purpose: Full-bleed photo with a white rounded panel overlapping its bottom edge, holding a heading and a stacked list of chevron links (or heading + text beside a second cell such as a person card)
visualCharacteristics.layout: Full-bleed 16:9 photo (21:9 from 900px); white 12px-radius panel pulled 64px up over the photo, 56px padding on desktop; H2 then link rows 32px apart with a 20px chevron on the right.

contentPattern.description: Full-bleed photo with an overlapping white panel: H2 + 11 links.
contentPattern.structure: Row 1: image. Row 2: panel content (H2, optional paragraph, bulleted list of links). Optional second cell in row 2 sits beside the first from 900px (e.g. a person card: portrait, name, job title, link).
contentPattern.notes: A list whose items are each a single link becomes the chevron link list; other lists render as normal lists.

usage.description: Full-bleed photo with an overlapping content panel (link list or split content).

reuseGuidance: Use for 'fields of expertise' style jump lists over a photo. Use hero-banner for a short clickable promo tile.
